question:
Select the figure from the options that can replace the question mark (?) and complete the pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee7d362f0f359a6975b3df89bf27a45b12708ceef5c07505798526cf9c44d269.png]
solution:
When we complete the figure by symmetrical lines we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ce5c5b12dbdbba9b1c2255013aa41cb75b270b0ca8c40964e77160b0fb558f7.png] 

Now we compare the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8914e2a68ce87aadc54497b55d101f9703d484018259bf7c9155a99e5bdf107f.png] The pattern is correct.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75b37e1d00f9302d579336b999970df8fb1ab43da58c050d743132c6009e171e.png] The dotted line is placed incorrectly.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89cd85366027a9a6087b3cef0d28162cb2ad270b4868e41657fe656703d1e0a9.png] The dotted line is placed incorrectly.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95963ba1c69ba2dadd6181054163c9a6b8f99489ce2afedbb55cdd0badfca046.png] The inner most line must be an arc.

Hence, the correct answer is **option (1)**
